title: Play Group
subtitle: Pre-Nursery
pedagogy: Fully play-based, oral and activity-driven. No formal written examination; assessment is through observation.
design_note: At 2-3 a child cannot read at all. The emoji IS the question — text is for the parent looking over the shoulder. Never more than 2 choices per screen.

delivery_legend.digital: Fully teachable on screen. The engine serves these.
delivery_legend.parent_guided: Physical-world learning. The app shows the parent an activity card and records completion — it does NOT fake a tap question for it.
delivery_legend.hybrid: Screen introduces it, a physical action completes it.

topics.title: Colours
topics.objective: Recognise red, yellow, blue, green, black and white; sort by colour
topics.intro_message: Look at all the pretty colours! 🎨

activities.prompt: This is red! 🟥 Red like an apple. 🍎
Which one is red like this? 🟥

topics.title: Shapes
topics.objective: Recognise circle, square and triangle; match same shapes
topics.intro_message: Let us find shapes! ⭕ 🟦 🔺

activities.prompt: This is a circle! ⭕ Round like a ball. ⚽

topics.title: Numbers 1 to 5
topics.objective: Oral counting 1-5, number recognition, counting objects, finger counting
topics.intro_message: Let us count on our fingers! ✋

activities.hint: Touch each apple as you count.

activities.prompt: Sing with me: One, two, buckle my shoe! 👞

topics.title: Pre-Number Concepts
topics.objective: Big/small, tall/short, long/short, heavy/light, more/less
topics.intro_message: Some things are big, some are small! 🐘 🐭

topics.title: Positions
topics.objective: In/out, up/down, open/close, front/back
topics.intro_message: Where is it? Let us look! 👀

activities.prompt: Is the cat IN or OUT of the box? 🐱📦
Is the balloon UP or DOWN? 🎈
Is the door OPEN or CLOSED? 🚪

topics.title: Matching & Sorting
topics.objective: Same and different, match the pair, sort by colour and size
topics.intro_message: Let us find the matching pairs! 🧩

activities.prompt: Which one is the same colour? 🟩
Which ball is the BIG one? 🏀 or ⚾

topics.title: Pre-Writing Strokes
topics.objective: Crayon grip, scribbling, standing/sleeping/slanting lines, curves, joining dots
topics.intro_message: Let us draw lines! ✏️

activities.prompt: Hold a fat crayon and scribble on paper! 🖍️📄
activities.parent_note: Fat crayons suit small hands. Do not correct the grip yet — at two, the goal is enjoying the mark-making.

topics.title: Capital Letters (A-E)
topics.objective: Oral identification and sound of A to E, one object per letter
topics.intro_message: Let us meet our first letters! 🅰️

activities.prompt: This is A! 🅰️ A for apple. 🍎
This is B! 🅱️ B for ball. ⚽
Which one starts with B? ⚽ or 🍎
This is C! C for cat. 🐱
This is D! D for dog. 🐶
This is E! E for egg. 🥚
Draw the letter A in sand or on a slate! 🅰️
activities.parent_note: A tray of atta or rice works well. Touching the shape teaches it faster than looking at it.

topics.title: Listening & Speaking
topics.objective: Greetings, own name and age, naming objects, one-step instructions
topics.intro_message: Let us talk together! 💬

activities.hint: Say it with a big smile 😊

activities.prompt: What is your name? Say it out loud! 🧒
Do what I say: Clap your hands! 👏
activities.parent_note: Give one instruction at a time. Two-step instructions come later — at two, one is plenty.

topics.title: Rhymes & Stories
topics.objective: 10-12 action rhymes, picture stories, animal and bird sounds
topics.intro_message: Story time! Listen carefully. 📖

activities.prompt: Sing with me: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star! ⭐
activities.hint: Open and close your hands like twinkling stars ✨

activities.prompt: Sing with me: The Wheels on the Bus! 🚌
activities.hint: Roll your hands round and round.

activities.prompt: Here is a story about a little duck! 🦆
activities.hint: Look at the pictures as I read.

topics.title: Colours: Red, Blue, Yellow
topics.objective: Meet red, blue and yellow, and find each one
topics.intro_message: Look around! The world is full of colours. 🌈

activities.prompt: This is red. 🟥 Red like an apple. 🍎
This is blue. 🟦 Blue like water. 💧
This is yellow. 🟨 Yellow like the sun. ☀️

topics.title: Colours: Green, Orange, Purple
topics.objective: Meet green, orange and purple, and find each one
topics.intro_message: Three more colours to meet! 🟩 🟧 🟣

activities.prompt: This is green. 🟩 Green like a leaf. 🍃
This is orange. 🟠 Orange like an orange fruit. 🍊
This is purple. 🟣 Purple like grapes. 🍇

topics.title: Colours: Pink, Black, White
topics.objective: Meet pink, black and white, and find each one
topics.intro_message: The last three colours. You are doing so well! 🌸

activities.prompt: This is pink. 🌸 Pink like a flower. 🌸
activities.hint: Pink is a soft, light colour.
Pink is a soft, light colour.

activities.prompt: This is black. ⚫ Black like the night sky. 🌙
This is white. ⚪ White like milk. 🥛

topics.title: Farm Animals: Cow, Dog, Cat
topics.objective: Meet the cow, the dog and the cat, and know their sounds
topics.intro_message: Let us meet the animals who live near our home! 🐄

activities.prompt: This is a cow. 🐄 The cow says moo.
This is a dog. 🐶 The dog says bow-wow.
This is a cat. 🐱 The cat says meow.
Which animal gives us milk? 🐄 or 🐱

topics.title: Farm Animals: Horse, Goat, Sheep
topics.objective: Meet the horse, the goat and the sheep
topics.intro_message: More farm friends are waiting for you! 🐴

activities.prompt: This is a horse. 🐴 The horse runs very fast.
activities.hint: We can ride on a horse.
We can ride on a horse.

activities.prompt: This is a goat. 🐐 The goat says maa.
This is a sheep. 🐑 The sheep is soft and woolly.
Which animal can we ride? 🐴 or 🐑
Which animal gives us soft wool? 🐑 or 🐐
activities.hint: Our sweaters come from sheep wool. 🧥

topics.title: Wild Animals: Lion, Tiger, Elephant
topics.objective: Meet the lion, the tiger and the elephant of the jungle
topics.intro_message: Now let us go to the jungle! 🦁

activities.prompt: This is a lion. 🦁 The lion roars very loudly.
This is a tiger. 🐯 The tiger has black stripes.
This is an elephant. 🐘 It has a long trunk.
Who roars in the jungle? 🦁 or 🐐
activities.hint: Roar! The lion is the king.

activities.prompt: Which animal has a long trunk? 🐘 or 🐯
activities.hint: It drinks water with its trunk.

topics.title: Wild Animals: Monkey, Bear, Giraffe
topics.objective: Meet the monkey, the bear and the giraffe
topics.intro_message: Three more jungle friends! 🐵

activities.prompt: This is a monkey. 🐵 It loves bananas. 🍌
activities.hint: It jumps from tree to tree.
It jumps from tree to tree.

activities.prompt: This is a bear. 🐻 The bear is big and furry.
This is a giraffe. 🦒 It has a very long neck.
Which animal has a very long neck? 🦒 or 🐵
activities.hint: It can eat the top leaves.

activities.prompt: Which animal is big and furry? 🐻 or 🦒
activities.hint: The bear is big and furry.

topics.title: Fruits: Apple, Banana, Mango
topics.objective: Meet the apple, the banana and the mango
topics.intro_message: Yummy! Let us meet some fruits. 🍎

activities.prompt: This is an apple. 🍎 It is red and sweet.
This is a banana. 🍌 It is long and yellow.
This is a mango. 🥭 It is sweet and juicy.
Which fruit is long and yellow? 🍌 or 🍎
Which one can we eat? 🥭 or 🚗

topics.title: Fruits: Orange, Grapes, Watermelon
topics.objective: Meet the orange, the grapes and the watermelon
topics.intro_message: Three more juicy fruits! 🍉

activities.prompt: This is an orange. 🍊 It is round and juicy.
These are grapes. 🍇 They are small and sweet.
This is a watermelon. 🍉 It is big, red and juicy.
Which fruit is the biggest? 🍉 or 🍇
Which fruit is small and purple? 🍇 or 🍊
Which fruit is round and orange? 🍊 or 🍉

topics.title: Vegetables: Potato, Tomato, Carrot
topics.objective: Meet the potato, the tomato and the carrot
topics.intro_message: Let us look inside the vegetable basket! 🧺

activities.prompt: This is a potato. 🥔 We make yummy chips from it.
This is a tomato. 🍅 It is round and red.
This is a carrot. 🥕 It is orange and crunchy.
The rabbit loves this one. 🐰 Which is the carrot? 🥕 or 🥔
Which one is a vegetable? 🥔 or 🍎

topics.title: Vegetables: Peas, Onion, Spinach
topics.objective: Meet the peas, the onion and the spinach
topics.intro_message: Three more vegetables from the basket! 🥬

activities.prompt: These are peas. 🫛 Small green balls in a pod.
This is an onion. 🧅 It makes our eyes water.
This is spinach. 🥬 Green leaves that make us strong.
Which one is green and leafy? 🥬 or 🧅
Which one makes our eyes water? 🧅 or 🫛
Which one is small and green? 🫛 or 🧅

topics.title: Transport: Car, Bus, Train
topics.objective: Meet the car, the bus and the train
topics.intro_message: Vroom vroom! Let us go for a ride. 🚗

activities.prompt: This is a car. 🚗 It goes on the road.
This is a bus. 🚌 It takes many children to school.
This is a train. 🚂 It says chhuk chhuk on the track.
Which one says chhuk chhuk? 🚂 or 🚗
activities.hint: The train runs on a track.

activities.prompt: Which one takes us to school? 🚌 or 🚂
Which one is small and goes on the road? 🚗 or 🚌
activities.hint: The car is smaller than the bus.

topics.title: Transport: Bicycle, Aeroplane, Boat
topics.objective: Meet the bicycle, the aeroplane and the boat
topics.intro_message: On the road, in the sky and on the water! ✈️

activities.prompt: This is a bicycle. 🚲 It has two wheels to pedal.
This is an aeroplane. ✈️ It flies high in the sky.
This is a boat. ⛵ It goes on the water.
Which one flies in the sky? ✈️ or ⛵
Which one goes on the water? ⛵ or 🚲
Which one has two wheels to pedal? 🚲 or ✈️

topics.title: Weather
topics.objective: Meet sunny, rainy, cloudy and windy days
topics.intro_message: Look outside! How is the weather today? ☀️

activities.prompt: It is sunny. ☀️ The sun is bright and warm.
It is rainy. 🌧️ Rain drops fall down.
It is cloudy. ☁️ Big clouds cover the sun.
It is windy. 💨 The wind blows the leaves.
We need an umbrella. ☂️ Which day is rainy? 🌧️ or ☀️
activities.hint: We open an umbrella in the rain.

activities.prompt: Which day is bright and warm? ☀️ or ☁️
